title: WeightWatchers Med+ vs FutureClinic: the clinic membership, or a doctor by message
summary: WeightWatchers Med+ vs FutureClinic compares Weight Watchers Clinic membership cost and GLP-1 pricing with a $40 FutureClinic visit to message a doctor.
body_markdown:
## What WeightWatchers Med+ costs vs paying per visit


As of October 2026,[WeightWatchers Med+ plans](https://www.weightwatchers.com/us/plans) cost $25 for month one on an auto-renewing 6- or 12-month plan, then "membership continues for $74/mo (12-month plan) or $84/mo (6-month plan)" ($445 for six months or $839 for a year). You stay subscribed to keep getting prescriptions through the program, which includes the GLP-1 Success Program, workshops, coaching, and oral kits ("metformin, bupropion, and/or naltrexone") via Carepoint. The "Cost of GLP-1 medications not included." WeightWatchers prescribes only FDA-approved drugs, accepts insurance for medicine ("As low as $0" for Wegovy with qualifying coverage), and prices[self-pay Wegovy](https://www.weightwatchers.com/us/weight-loss-medication/wegovy-pill) at $149 to $299/mo (pill) and $349/mo ($249/mo with 12-month prepay, pen) via CenterWell Pharmacy as of October 2026.


Any licensed doctor can prescribe to maker self-pay programs or retail pharmacies without a clinic subscription. Through[NovoCare](https://www.novocare.com/delivery.html) as of October 2026, cash-pay Wegovy ([$1,349.02 list](https://www.novocare.com/patient/medicines/wegovy.html) ) costs $149/mo at 1.5 mg (30 tablets), $199/mo at 4 mg, and $299/mo at 9 or 25 mg for the pill, while the pen costs $199/mo for the first two fills (0.25 and 0.5 mg, new patients through December 31, 2026) and $349/mo after ($399/mo at 7.2 mg). On[LillyDirect](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/zepbound) as of October 2026, self-pay Zepbound KwikPens cost $299/mo at 2.5 mg (matching 2.5 mg[vials](https://zepbound.lilly.com/savings) ), $399/mo at 5 mg, and $449/mo at 7.5 to 15 mg when refilled within 45 days ($499 to $699 otherwise); retail[TrumpRx](https://trumprx.gov/p/wegovy) coupons list the Wegovy pill at $149/mo and pen at $199/mo initially ($349/mo after); commercial[savings cards](https://www.wegovy.com/obesity/what-to-pay-for-wegovy.html) lower copays to as little as $25/mo ($100/mo maximum savings); and eligible Part D enrollees pay[$50/mo](https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/weight-loss-drugs) via the[Medicare GLP-1 Bridge](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coverage/prescription-drug-coverage/medicare-glp-1-bridge) from July 1, 2026, to December 31, 2027.


On FutureClinic, no subscription is needed: a single visit costs $40 for the best-fit doctor in the clinic, or you can pick a specific physician at their listed fee, typically $20 to $100. If your doctor decides it's right for you, prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door, with a cash discount coupon, or you can use insurance at the pharmacy (FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations). For a stable medicine, your doctor can prescribe several months at once when they judge it safe. Most doctors offer an optional membership, typically $25 to $100 a month, for unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time.


## Do you want the WeightWatchers program, or a doctor one to one?


WeightWatchers Med+ suits you if you want its workshops, coaching, dietitians, video visits, and oral kits in a 6- or 12-month plan. If all you wanted was an expert doctor directly, FutureClinic lets you[pay per visit](https://futureclinic.com/blog/telehealth-subscriptions-vs-paying-a-doctor-per-visit-yearly-cost) to message the same physician for weight, discounted labs, and other problems in their specialty.


## A doctor for your weight-loss questions, state by state


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. Your doctor must hold a license in the state you're in, and if you don't see your state, try anyway.


Start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) or reach a doctor from the AI app you already use (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse, or Instinct) at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) (see our[Claude](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-doctor-to-claude) and[ChatGPT](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-real-doctor-to-chatgpt) guides), or send:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis. See our[editorial standards](https://futureclinic.com/blog/editorial-standards) .
